original_design_assumption: SERVS and SWIRE partly share photons.
source_verified_clarification: Mauduit2012 section3.3 identifies earlier SIMPLE/GOODS and SpUDS frames patched into SERVS. This does not establish photon overlap with our SWIRE catalogue. SERVS DR1 section2.3 explicitly calibrates IRAC3.6 to SWIRE, factor1.02 for CDFS/XMM already applied. Use shared instrument/calibration and exposure-level independence not audited; do not assert overlapping SWIRE photons.
effect: Interpretation clarification only, unchanged catalogue/sample/matching/flux analysis.
